explanation: Write r=√(x²+y²). The top disk has zero flux because F's z-component is zero. On the lower cone h=r−4, the outward vector area element is ⟨x/r,y/r,−1⟩ dA. Thus the integrand is (−y)x/r+(r−4)y/r=y−(xy+4y)/r, giving option d. Other choices also integrate to zero by symmetry, but d follows directly from the surface calculation.
